One row per photo: source zip, original file name, detail link, favorite/save counts and who favorited/saved it, then title, caption, size, dimensions, camera EXIF, uploader and dates. `collection=favorites|saves` keeps only photos someone favorited/saved (`mine=true`: only yours); `album=<id>` keeps only the photos in that album; `ids=1,2,3` only those photos. info.title: Pre-Wedding View API
info.description: Public pre-wedding photo gallery with per-user favorites and saves, and admin photo management.

permissions.description: Effective permissions. Admins have all of them; users only those granted. Viewing, favorites, saves and sharing need none.

previewUrl.description: 2048px WebP for viewing, rotation applied. Falls back to `url` until generated.

width.description: Displayed width in pixels (EXIF orientation and admin rotation applied).

rotation.description: Clockwise rotation an admin applied on top of EXIF orientation.

isFavorite.description: Present only when a valid token was sent.

isSaved.description: Present only when a valid token was sent.

deletedAt.description: Only ever non-null on admin responses.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the original. Detail only.

exif.description: Camera/lens/exposure EXIF of the original. Detail only. GPS and serial numbers are never included.

originalName.description: Admin only: the uploaded file name.

albums.description: Detail only: the albums this photo is in (hidden albums only for album managers).

files.description: 1 to 20 JPEG, PNG or WebP files, max 15 MB each

title.description: Omit to keep each title; empty clears it.

caption.description: Omit to keep each caption; empty clears it.

changed.description: How many photos actually changed (missing ones, or ones already in that state, are skipped).

photos.description: The photos that were rotated, as they are now.

failed.description: Ids whose re-render failed; those photos are unchanged.

on.description: true adds them, false removes them.

grants.description: Extra actions granted to a user role. Ignored for admins.

permissions.description: What the account can actually do.

username.description: Stored lowercase. 2-32 characters: letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.

password.description: 8-128 characters. Omit to have a strong one generated.

generatedPassword.description: Present only when the server generated the password. Shown once; it is not stored.

disabled.description: Disabling signs the account out everywhere and blocks login.

password.description: 8-128 characters. Omit to have a strong one generated.

token.description: The unguessable part of the link.

path.description: Path of the share page on the web app.

visibility.description: `public`: anyone with the link. `private`: only the listed people (signed in), the creator and admins.

photoCount.description: Active (not trashed) photos in the link.

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working (null = never).

canManage.description: The caller can edit or delete this link (its creator, or an admin).

people.description: Who a private link is for. Only sent to people who can manage the link.

received.description: Private links shared with you (not expired), newest first.

userIds.description: Account ids a private link is for (required when private).

expiresInDays.description: Days until the link stops working (1–365); null or omitted = never.

photoIds.description: 1 to 5000 photo ids. Missing or trashed ones are skipped.

userIds.description: Account ids a private link is for (required when private).

expiresInDays.description: Days until the link stops working (1–365); null or omitted = never.

hidden.description: Hidden albums are only listed for accounts with `albums.manage`.

photoCount.description: Active (not trashed) photos in the album.

cover.description: The chosen cover, else the newest photo in the album.

coverPhotoId.description: The explicitly chosen cover photo id (null = automatic).

slug.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Generated from the name when omitted.

hidden.description: Hide from guests and users while you build it.

photoIds.description: Photos to put in the album straight away.

slug.description: Changing it breaks links shared with the old one.

coverPhotoId.description: A photo in the album, or null for automatic (newest photo).

changed.description: How many photos were actually added / removed (already-there or missing ones are skipped).
